import bpy,json,collections,math
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Vector
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent
c=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Craft']
records=[]
for o in c.objects:
 if o.type not in ['MESH','CURVE','FONT']:continue
 pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(v) for v in o.bound_box]
 rec={'name':o.name,'type':o.type,'min':[min(p[i] for p in pts) for i in range(3)],'max':[max(p[i] for p in pts) for i in range(3)],'materials':[m.name for m in o.data.materials if m],'modifiers':[(m.name,m.type,getattr(m,'width',None)) for m in o.modifiers],'skip':bool(o.get('sp13_skip_export'))}
 records.append(rec)
out=root/'captures/shipyard_ground_20261114'
(out/'source_before.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
matcount=collections.Counter(m for o in records for m in o['materials'])
stone=[o for o in records if any(t in o['name'] for t in ['terrace paving','coping','retaining','foundation','access','threshold','dock wall','quay'])]
print(json.dumps({'objects':len(records),'materials':matcount,'stone_samples':stone[:30],'stone_names':[o['name'] for o in stone][30:100]},ensure_ascii=False))
